description.zh:
MANUAL（手动）：仅限使用标注工具重建时使用此参数（默认调用参数）；
SEMI_AUTOMATIC（自动）：仅限基于App端进行自动化建模时使用；
description.en:
Valid values:

- MANUAL: Use this value only when reconstructing with the annotation tool. This is the default value.
- SEMI_AUTOMATIC: Use this value only when performing automated modeling from the app.

description.zh: 模型效果 PATCH：切片模型（默认） DEPTH：深度模型
description.en:
The model style. Valid values:

- PATCH: Patch model. This is the default value.
- DEPTH: Depth model.

description.zh: 墙宽优化，OFF：关闭（默认） NORMAL：标准 ENHANCED：加强
description.en:
The wall width optimization mode. Valid values:

- OFF: Disabled. This is the default value.
- NORMAL: Standard optimization.
- ENHANCED: Enhanced optimization.

The floor plan style. Valid values:

- DEFAULT: The default style.
- STANDARD: The standard style.

description.zh: 墙高，默认0不设置，范围200-1000. 单位cm
description.en: The wall height. Default value: 0, which indicates that the wall height is not set. Valid values: 200 to 1000. Unit: cm.
